title: Leveraging Large Language Models in Human-Robot Interaction: A Critical Analysis of Potential and Pitfalls

bias_targets.methodology: Meta-study and literature review of HRI papers, analyzing the need for affirmative action strategies to minimize stereotypical thinking and biased perceptions of specific genders in LLM-driven robots.
Literature review assessing the risks of algorithmic bias and stereotype enhancement originating from LLM training data when deployed in socially assistive robots.
